scripts.title: Dark Jump
scripts.script:
--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

--// Player
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

--// State
local AutoJumpEnabled = false
local JUMP_DELAY = 0.1
local lastJump = 0

--// GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AutoJumpUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--// Button
local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
Button.Name = "AutoJumpButton"
Button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70)
Button.Position = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.15, 0)

-- Background
Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- White
Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5

-- Text
Button.Text = "AUTO JUMP: OFF"
Button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) -- Black
Button.TextTransparency = 0
Button.TextScaled = true -- ✅ FIXED
Button.TextWrapped = true

Button.AutoButtonColor = false
Button.Active = true
Button.Draggable = true
Button.Parent = ScreenGui

--// Corner (100% round)
local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) -- ✅ 100 / fully round
Corner.Parent = Button

--// Border (NOT text)
local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Name = "Border"
Stroke.Thickness = 2
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) -- Black
Stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border -- ✅ FIXED
Stroke.Parent = Button

--// Button Toggle
Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	AutoJumpEnabled = not AutoJumpEnabled

	if AutoJumpEnabled then
		Button.Text = "AUTO JUMP: ON"
	else
		Button.Text = "AUTO JUMP: OFF"
	end

	-- Force visual safety
	Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
end)

--// Auto Jump Logic
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not AutoJumpEnabled then return end

	local char = Player.Character
	if not char then return end

	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end

	if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
		if os.clock() - lastJump >= JUMP_DELAY then
			lastJump = os.clock()
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end
end)

warn("✅ Auto Jump GUI Loaded (TextScaled ON, Border Fixed)")

-- Xeno Executor Optimized Script
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

-- 1. Tạo Tool (Quả cam)
local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
tool.Name = "🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊🍊"
tool.RequiresHandle = true

local handle = Instance.new("Part")
handle.Name = "Handle"
handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
handle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0) -- Màu cam đậm
handle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
handle.Parent = tool

-- Đưa Tool vào Backpack
tool.Parent = backpack

-- 2. Logic xử lý khi sử dụng
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    -- Tăng tốc độ chạy (WalkSpeed)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
    end

    -- Hàm gửi chat 20 lần (Tương thích 2025)
    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 1, 20 do
            -- Kiểm tra hệ thống TextChatService mới (Thường dùng trong năm 2025)
            if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
                if channel then
                    channel:SendAsync("orange")
                end
            else
                -- Hệ thống Legacy Chat cũ
                local chatRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
                if chatRemote and chatRemote:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
                    chatRemote.SayMessageRequest:FireServer("orange", "All")
                end
            end
            
            task.wait(0.1) -- Nghỉ 0.1s để không bị hệ thống chống spam kick
        end
    end)

    -- Xóa quả cam sau khi đã sử dụng
    tool:Destroy()
end)

-- Thông báo cho người dùng Xeno
print("Xeno: Orange Script Loaded! Check your Backpack.")

scripts.title: egg burger
scripts.script:
-- EGG BURGER "YUM YUM" CHAT TOOL (2025)
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Backpack = Player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

-- 1. Tạo Tool
local EggBurger = Instance.new("Tool")
EggBurger.Name = "🍳 Egg Burger"
EggBurger.RequiresHandle = true
EggBurger.Parent = Backpack

-- 2. Tạo Handle (Bánh Egg Burger chân thực bằng Parts)
local Handle = Instance.new("Part")
Handle.Name = "Handle"
Handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.4, 1)
Handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(193, 154, 107)
Handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
Handle.Parent = EggBurger

local function AddLayer(color, size, offset, name, material)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = name
    p.Size = size
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Parent = EggBurger
    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    w.Part0 = Handle; w.Part1 = p; w.Parent = p
    p.CFrame = Handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, offset, 0)
end

AddLayer(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(1.1, 0.1, 1.1), 0.25, "White") -- Lòng trắng
AddLayer(Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0), Vector3.new(0.5, 0.15, 0.5), 0.3, "Yolk", Enum.Material.Neon) -- Lòng đỏ
AddLayer(Color3.fromRGB(193, 154, 107), Vector3.new(1, 0.4, 1), 0.5, "TopBun") -- Bánh trên

-- 3. Xử lý khi ăn (Click chuột)
EggBurger.Activated:Connect(function()
    -- Âm thanh ăn
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", Character.Head)
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://13114759"
    sound:Play()

    -- NHÂN VẬT NÓI "YUM YUM!"
    -- 1. Gửi vào khung chat hệ thống
    local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral
        channel:SendAsync("Yum yum!")
    else
        -- Dành cho các game dùng hệ thống chat cũ
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer("Yum yum!", "All")
    end

    -- 2. Hiện Bubble Chat trên đầu (Dành cho bản thân thấy rõ hơn)
    game:GetService("Chat"):Chat(Character.Head, "Yum yum!", Enum.ChatColor.White)

    -- Thông báo màn hình
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "🍳 Egg Burger",
        Text = "so good and tasty!",
        Duration = 2
    })

    -- Xóa bánh sau khi ăn
    EggBurger:Destroy()
end)

-- 4. Tự động cầm bánh
Character.Humanoid:EquipTool(EggBurger)

print("Egg Burger 'Yum Yum' đã kích hoạt!")

scripts.title: burger
scripts.script:
-- SCRIPT BURGER TĂNG TỐC (DÀNH CHO EXECUTOR)
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Backpack = Player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

-- 1. Tạo Tool
local Burger = Instance.new("Tool")
Burger.Name = "Cái Bánh Burger"
Burger.RequiresHandle = true
Burger.Parent = Backpack

-- 2. Tạo Handle (Lớp bánh dưới)
local Handle = Instance.new("Part")
Handle.Name = "Handle"
Handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.2, 0.8)
Handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(193, 154, 107) -- Màu bánh mì
Handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
Handle.Parent = Burger

-- 3. Tạo các lớp thịt và rau (Bằng Part để chắc chắn hiển thị)
local function AddLayer(color, height, name)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = name
    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.1, 0.8)
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Parent = Burger
    
    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    w.Part0 = Handle
    w.Part1 = p
    w.Parent = p
    p.CFrame = Handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, height, 0)
end

AddLayer(Color3.fromRGB(102, 51, 0), 0.15, "Meat")   -- Thịt nâu
AddLayer(Color3.fromRGB(40, 127, 71), 0.25, "Salad") -- Rau xanh
AddLayer(Color3.fromRGB(193, 154, 107), 0.35, "Top") -- Bánh trên

-- 4. Thông số Speed
local SPEED_BOOST = 100 -- Tốc độ khi ăn
local DURATION = 10     -- Thời gian tăng tốc (giây)

-- 5. Khi Click để ăn
Burger.Activated:Connect(function()
    local Hum = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if Hum then
        local oldSpeed = Hum.WalkSpeed
        Hum.WalkSpeed = SPEED_BOOST
        
        -- Thông báo
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "🍔 Măm măm!",
            Text = "Tăng tốc thành công!",
            Duration = 3
        })

        Burger:Destroy() -- Ăn xong thì biến mất
        
        task.wait(DURATION)
        if Hum then Hum.WalkSpeed = oldSpeed end
    end
end)

-- 6. ÉP BUỘC HIỆN TRÊN TAY
Character.Humanoid:EquipTool(Burger)
